column1: # One line per allowed literal, TAB-separated:
# Rules, and why they are these rules:
#  * A reason is MANDATORY. An allow-list with reasons stays maintained; a pile
#    of unexplained patterns is how a check gets quietly switched off.
#  * The EXPECTED LITERAL is part of the key, so swapping a real secret in at an
#    allow-listed location still fails the scan. Only ever list a value that is
#    safe to publish — every entry here is a self-describing placeholder.
#  * Entries are per LOCATION, never per file. A file-level exclusion would hide
#    the next real hit in the same file.
#  * A stale entry (matching nothing) FAILS the scan too, so this file cannot
#    quietly drift out of step with the code.
